notes.title: Update Postponed
notes.notes:
As announced earlier on X (formerly Twitter), the update scheduled for 10/31 has been
We have decided to postpone the update scheduled for 10/31 until 11/08.

Reason
Due to certain circumstances, we thought that the date of 10/31 would reduce the opportunity for Steam users to play the game.
We have completed most of the updates as previously announced (except for the font change).
We will also use the time saved by the postponement to add a few more effects.

Changes from the previous update
The following is a list of additional changes to the previous update.
The changes have not yet been applied to the current version of the software.

　We have eliminated the “attack, damage taken, enemy appears” role.
　Enemies will now have a certain probability of appearing when a spin is made during non-combat.
　Attacks and damage taken will now alternate with each spin.
　Also, the enemy's attack will be a random attack of 1~3 hits.
　The main character will be able to attack any number of times out of 1~3 by charging coins to the attack gauge.

　Reach and chance eyes that have a certain probability of winning a bonus will be implemented.
　When a bonus is won by itself, a special direction will be executed with a certain probability.
　When a bonus is won, the lower left panel will announce that the bonus has been won.

　We have already announced that the font will be changed, but this is expected to be a time-consuming process,
　We will prioritize other updates in the 11/08 update,
　The font change will be made in the next update.
　If there are many requests for the font change to be prioritized here,
　If we receive enough requests for the font change to be prioritized, there is a possibility that the update date will be further postponed.


The above is in addition to the previously announced updates.
If you would like to see other updates in advance, please refer to the previous post.
If you would like to see other updates, please refer to our previous post, “Major Update Details Released in Advance”.

notes.title: Pre-release of major update details
notes.notes:
All currently scheduled updates will be made public.
Please note that these are currently planned and may change in the future.

Changes to the overall game
　Four stages will be changed so that players can select one of them at the title screen.
　The second and subsequent stages will be made playable by clearing the previous stage.

Changes related to combat
　When the game is over/the game is cleared, the player is returned to the title and the contents related to coins and mushrooms are reset.
　When the game is over/game is cleared, skill points will be awarded according to the results.
　Add HP to enemies.

About Boss Battles
　The special game system currently used for boss battles will be abolished.
　We are currently thinking of adopting the same format as normal battles, but this is still likely to be changed.

Changes related to skills
　We will move the skill button to the title screen and change it so that skills can no longer be opened in-game.
　The cost to purchase skills will be changed from coins to skill points.
　The content of skills will also be changed significantly in areas affected by this change.

Changes to the store
　The store button will be eliminated.
　Recovery will be available for purchase at the mushroom selection screen at the end of a battle.
　Other items that were previously available in the store will be removed.　
　
Changes to mushrooms
　Mushroom skills will be changed so that they do not decrease with the passage of turns, etc.
　We will make overall changes to the skills of mushrooms.
　(This change will make the player stronger the more mushrooms he eats.)
　Mushrooms will be made available for acquisition after the battle, with a choice of several mushrooms.
　Also, when acquiring mushrooms, players will pay coins according to the price of the mushrooms.
　Mushrooms will also be available outside of battle on rare occasions.
　Mushroom growth will occur each turn, and the number of mushrooms matched in a slot will be used to further advance the growth stage of the mushroom.

Slots
　The probability of winning a slot will be reduced and the payout will be increased.
　The obsolete skill button and store button will be replaced with a stop button, allowing the player to stop all three reels at any time.
　All action-related roles will be changed so that they depend on the result of eye-pushing.
　We are also planning to reflect the result of eye-pushers on the payout roles.

Other small changes
　The font of the dots is very difficult to see, so we plan to change the font for long sentences such as skill descriptions.
　We will add detailed descriptions such as when the probability changes depending on the climate and skills.

These are the currently planned updates.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Update Details and Next Update
notes.notes:
This time, we changed the mushrooms you get when you defeat an enemy.
This time, we changed the mushrooms you get when you defeat an enemy so that you can choose from three options.
In addition, in the recent update schedule, we had announced that we would change the probability and payout of slots, but we did not update these items this time.
We have concluded that this update will not be made without the scheduled updates, and that it may upset the balance of the game.

About the next update
We had planned to update the game little by little, but due to the nature of the game and the interaction of various elements, we have decided to update the game after all the planned changes have been implemented.
The next update is scheduled for October 31, but the schedule may change due to the long span of implementation work. Please understand.

We will provide all the details regarding the next update in a new post tomorrow.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Minimal functional additions, etc. / Next update
notes.notes:
Here are the contents of last night's (10/05) update.

Fixed a bug that prevented the spin button from being pressed under certain conditions.
Damage text is now more scattered.
(Fixed a situation where damage notations overlapped, making 1 x 3 damage look like 111 damage.)
Changed the long-press rotation to the initial implementation.
Added black borders to white text that was difficult to see due to color.
Added commas for every 1000 in numbers. (The font will be changed in the near future.)

Added functions
Changed so that the ESC key can be used to display the settings screen.
Added master volume to the settings screen.
Window/fullscreen can be changed in the settings window.


Next update
This time, we have fixed small issues first, considering that frequent updates will not be possible due to the major update work that is in progress.
In the next update, we plan to implement the following
　Reduce the overall winning rate of slots and increase the payout.
　Allow mushrooms to have 3 options to choose from after the battle is over.
The next update will be made on 10/09 at around 23:00.
